title: [Web] Audio sample playback ignores pitch_scale for autoplay, and 2nd+ loops.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.2 (and latest master ca871ccc9cd8e5c2ce829ec5c0fae1ac32c6269f). it's likely reproducible since the beginning of web samples playback, but at least as far back as [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/93362/changes#diff-9008639a3ed62166e1681f16d4c2149f83209ff5327f500dd795843a1747076aR638)

### System information

Intel MBP 15.7.9 - AMD Radeon Pro 5300M 4 GB Intel UHD Graphics 630 - but shouldn't matter.

### Issue description

I know the guidance in the issue template says to submit separate issues for separate bugs, but these two bugs can be fixed by the same LOC change, and are closely related to one another (just with a slight twist).

I have put together a small fix for this and will open a PR shortly. 

For web samples playback, pitch_scale is ignored in two cases: 
1. AudioStreamPlayer with autoplay=true (works fine when calling .play() directly)
2. On the 2nd+ loops of a sample

The autoplay flavor of this bug has an additional codepath that seems to be broken (or at least, unintentionally called): the `pause(enable:bool)` method calls `_unpause`, which then unconditionally calls `_restart`, regardless of if the stream was playing or not. 

(no ai used at all.)

### Steps to reproduce

Autoplay bug:
1. Add AudioStreamPlayer to scene
2. Set autoplay=true
4. Set pitch_scale=2
5. Run scene: audio is playing at pitch_scale=1.

Loop bug:
1. Add AudioStreamPlayer to scene
2. Set autoplay=false
3. Set pitch_scale=2
4. Add an audio stream that has looping enabled
5. Attach script, `_ready(): player.play()` (important!)
6. Run scene: audio will play with pitch_scale=2 properly, until it loops. at this point, pitch_scale is 1.0.

The cause of the pitch_scale problems is that _restart does not sync the playback rate when it creates a new AudioBufferSourceNode. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This scene is configured to test both of these bugs. 

[pitch_mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32592806/pitch_mrp.zip)
